decisions.reason: The rebranded 518 FLEX builds on the well-received BASIC 518 and has its own page, so its results appear to meet the aspiration and give no reason for problemistic search.
The flail shredders have a dedicated page and fit the core recycling portfolio, and the firm's organisational slack lets it carry them while their results are still uncertain.
The grinder is only mentioned on the website, which suggests weaker results, but one year of evidence is too little to fall clearly below aspiration and trigger a drop.
The electric fine shredder is only mentioned and its results are uncertain, but it fits the resource-saving, tougher-processing strategy, so slack lets the firm keep it for now.
The green-waste grinder may overlap with Product C and has low visibility, which makes it the most likely candidate for consolidation, but it is still too early to judge it a shortfall.
The pre-shredders have a page of their own and fit the stationary plant business, so they appear to be performing in line with aspirations.
